verdict.rationale: Together AI is an inference and training platform, and a built-in console assistant is a fair axis for such a SaaS product. However, the evidence shows no built-in assistant to which users can delegate tasks. Agent skills and the docs MCP server equip external coding agents, and function calling is a developer building block for building agents, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
